escena: SCENE: a spectacular live-action ACTION FILM still inside a monumental dark creative-production hangar. Nexa is caught at the end of a decisive lateral step, knees and torso braced diagonally, NOT leaning toward the camera, from upper thighs up on frame-right. Her RIGHT arm is fully visible from shoulder to elbow to fingertips as she intercepts ONE luminous rectangular FILM FRAME at chest height between her thumb and forefinger, below and to frame-LEFT of her chin, never covering her face or chest mark. The frame has a rigid pale CERAMIC BORDER and contains a miniature landscape image, without letters. The ceramic border is a physical object, not a light source; the image inside emits azure-white light. Its top-right corner has one small triangular notch, recognizable for a later controlled edit. A turbulent stream of hundreds of DARK ALTERNATIVE FRAMES recedes BEHIND her into the right-hand depth at 5 to 12 metres. Their trajectories imply speed; they are heavily defocused, not suspended physical shards, not an evenly spaced fan, and none is sharp like the foreground frame. Only her eyes, the held frame and the near Research Spark are sharp. Her other arm hangs naturally, one manual action only. The Research Spark is perched on her LEFT shoulder on frame-right, tiny hands gripping the shoulder, with its magnifying glass clear of her face, smaller than her head. ONE Spark only. Both of her eyes face the camera through the clear glasses with determined concentration, not a model smile. The selected frame is the ONLY hard azure-white key, 30 cm below and frame-left of the face, casting a visible nose shadow on the far cheek. A very low cool rear rim, neutral human skin and neutral white armour, navy fabric, no blue wash. Thin haze catches the ONE narrow light beam; huge real structural ribs and cold practicals at 8 to 12 metres provide scale and bokeh. CAMERA at chest height, 85 mm f/1.8, approximately 2.8 metres away, head about one quarter of frame height, shoulders wider than two head widths, no extreme foreshortening. Empty textured dark hangar to the LEFT of the held frame and her elbow: nothing bright crosses that boundary. The near-black matte edge of the loading ramp is ten cm from the lens along the very bottom, native to the scene, not a desk, below her body and hands. Exact bionic suit and chest isotype from the kit, exact transparent bionic glasses, small GOLD earrings, no watch, no bracelet, no ring. No added editorial logo, no captions, no readable text, no destruction. This is fiction, not a real event.

lecho.objeto: the native near-black matte rubber edge of the loading ramp, ten centimetres from the lens at the bottom of the image, completely out of focus, below all hands and bodies; no reflections and outside the reach of the key light

texto.muro: the unlit textured hangar wall and space on the LEFT, clear of all hands, characters, frames and beams

llave.fuente: the ONE postcard-sized azure-white film frame held in her RIGHT hand
llave.lado: below her chin and to frame-LEFT of her face

fondo: immense structural ribs and gantries at 8 to 12 metres in the hangar on the right, with large cold practical lights melted into bokeh; the architecture is physical, not a black studio void

fenomeno.que: one azure-white film frame has been selected from a deep turbulent stream of dark alternative frames; its light creates the only narrow beam in the haze
fenomeno.esServicio: Elegir una imagen y conservar la dirección creativa entre alternativas: la acción es seleccionar, no coleccionar resultados; esta ficción visual no acredita una tasa de acierto.

nota: Ficción cinematográfica propia para Glitch Flash Images 2.6. Prueba explícita del operador con motor gpt-image-2.6-sunburst, no cambio de default ni identidad nueva.
